candidates.mechanism: Crude oil leads equities through the inflation -> policy-rate channel (oil -> CPI -> Fed path -> yields -> equity valuations); the donor's check: is the week's yield move oil-driven? Literature: Driesprong, Jacobsen & Maat (2008) oil changes predict lower next-month stock returns.
candidates.title: US500 lead_lag (B-HD-07)
candidates.falsifier: Same-sign or zero response; effect only in 2020/2022 energy shocks.
